strings: Poor m_c's woken up with a headache. Asking for r_c0, {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/worry/worries} about how it will impair {PRONOUN/m_c/object}.
Grumbling, m_c makes {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} way to the medicine den to get some herbs to chase away a headache.
Resolutely, m_c ignores the dull throb in {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} head in the hopes that ignoring it will make it vanish.
After all the squinting m_c's been doing trying to clearly see things, {PRONOUN/m_c/subject}{VERB/m_c/'re/'s} not surprised to have a bit of a headache.
Waking up, m_c lets out a small groan. It seems like it will be a bad day with {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} head swimming a bit.
